cargo: Ohm Cargo base 461a3d1007ecc997a6d86c7d75e8b518575c8d90 with and without only the fix, both with identical release features, compiler, PGO input and canonical paths
test: 12 paired independent warm native→check invocations on the small reproducer, each in a new target and build store bound at a fixed path, with the same Cargo registry. Reproduce in the full Ruff workspace from a genuinely warmed native state for each arm; require two consecutive candidate successes and a fresh repeat and compare the fixed diagnostics to a separate clean reference. Baseline valid failure must cite a colliding StableCrateId. Do not compare elapsed time for a failed baseline to elapsed time for a successful command.
analysis: Two-sided exact paired sign test on the pass/fail outcome for the small fixture, excluding ties. Preserve the independent full Ruff run, all failed runs, and any control that exposes an unexpected alternative error. A correct check must compile the downstream type equality, remain fresh on repetition, and keep a separate eligible dependency native. No time savings claim for turning a failure into success.
